name: dataset-clean
desc: Free, open-source dataset cleaner for Windows — finds blurry, tiny, broken and mislabeled training images. 100 MB portable, offline, MIT.
features: ✅ **Blur scoring** — Laplacian variance ranking surfaces the soft shots that teach a model nothing
✅ **Resolution floor** — flags anything under your minimum edge length for the planned training resolution
✅ **Corrupt file detection** — truncated JPEGs and unreadable files found before the trainer crashes on them
✅ **Caption pair check** — images without captions and orphan captions without images listed together
✅ **Review before action** — problems grouped by type with thumbnails; decide per item or in bulk
✅ **HTML report** — shareable quality report of the dataset with every finding
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, portable, fully offline, MIT with SHA-256 releases
compare: | Feature | **dataset-clean** | Manual review | Scripts | Generic dupe finders |
| Price | **Free, MIT** | Your evening | Free, OSS | Free or paid |
| Blur quality scoring | **Yes** | Eyeball only | Scripted | No |
| Caption pair validation | **Yes** | Rare | Scripted | No |
| Grouped findings report | **Yes** | No | No | Partial
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | N/A | Python env | Varies
faqQ: why does my LoRA look blurry? how to find bad images in a dataset
faqA: A model learns whatever is in the set, including the blurry, tiny and corrupt files nobody opened. dataset-clean scores sharpness, checks resolution and caption pairs, and groups findings for fast bulk decisions. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, offline, and it reports before it touches a single file.
s1: Dark audit (#121418, cyan #22D3EE): findings sidebar with blur, low-res and corrupt groups, image grid sorted worst-first, score chip reading blur 12.4.
s2: Caption pair view: three problem rows — image missing caption, orphan txt, empty caption — with open-folder and bulk-fix buttons.
s3: HTML report preview: quality summary cards with percentages, worst offenders strip at bottom, export button, toast reading report saved.
